subproblems.title: Calculus of the straight-line interpolation map y ↦ f(tail y) + y_0 (g(tail y) − f(tail y))
subproblems.statement: For all N, N' ∈ ℕ and C^∞ maps f, g : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) there is a C^∞ map h : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} such that, with ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), Jv := ι(0, v), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 and D = fderiv ℝ, for all t ∈ ℝ and x, v ∈ ℝ^N: (a) h(ι(t, x)) = f(x) + t(g(x) − f(x)); (b) Dh(ι(t, x))e₀ = g(x) − f(x); (c) Dh(ι(t, x))(Jv) = Df(x)v + t(Dg(x)v − Df(x)v); (d) ‖Dh(ι(t, x))‖ ≤ ‖g(x) − f(x)‖ + ‖Df(x)‖ + |t|(‖Dg(x)‖ + ‖Df(x)‖) (operator norms).

subproblems.natural_proof:
Source: parent proof step 2(a), 2(b) (the interpolation H_j(y) := F_j(tail y) + y_0·(G_j(tail y) − F_j(tail y)) and its derivative), carried out for arbitrary C^∞ maps f, g. Notation: ℝ^N = Euclid N; ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (the point (t, x_1, …, x_N)); Jv := ι(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; D = fderiv ℝ; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF(x)); NC X means IsCompact X.support, X.mass < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞; C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}; d := exteriorDerivative, on test forms exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m (whose coercion is exteriorDerivative of the coercion, by rfl).
1. Coordinate maps. Let tl : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^N, tl(y) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp y)) (delete coordinate 0), and hd : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ, hd(y) := y_0 (EuclideanSpace.proj 0). tl is additive and homogeneous (both identities hold coordinatewise, by rfl), so it is a linear map and, the spaces being finite dimensional, a continuous linear map (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap); hd is continuous linear (EuclideanSpace.proj).
2. Values. Since Fin.tail (Fin.cons t p) = p and (Fin.cons t p) 0 = t, we get tl(ι(t, x)) = x and hd(ι(t, x)) = t for all t, x; in particular tl(Jv) = v and hd(Jv) = 0. All coordinates i.succ of e₀ = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 vanish and its coordinate 0 is 1, so tl(e₀) = 0 and hd(e₀) = 1.
3. Norms. For w ∈ ℝ^{N+1}, ‖w‖² = |w_0|² + Σ_{i<N} |w_{i+1}|² and ‖tl w‖² = Σ_{i<N} |w_{i+1}|² (EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succ), hence ‖tl w‖ ≤ ‖w‖ (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt); and |hd w| = |w_0| ≤ ‖w‖ (PiLp.norm_apply_le).
4. Definition. Put h(y) := f(tl y) + hd(y)·(g(tl y) − f(tl y)). Continuous linear maps are C^∞ and f, g are C^∞, so h is C^∞ (ContDiff.comp, ContDiff.sub, ContDiff.smul, ContDiff.add).
5. Claim (a). By step 2, h(ι(t, x)) = f(x) + t·(g(x) − f(x)).
6. Derivative. f and g are differentiable (C^∞). By the chain rule, f∘tl has derivative Df(tl y)∘tl at y, and g∘tl has derivative Dg(tl y)∘tl. By the product rule for a scalar function times a vector-valued function (HasFDerivAt.smul with c := hd, whose derivative is hd itself), y ↦ hd(y)·(g(tl y) − f(tl y)) has derivative hd(y)·(Dg(tl y)∘tl − Df(tl y)∘tl) + hd.smulRight(g(tl y) − f(tl y)). Adding (HasFDerivAt.add) and using HasFDerivAt.fderiv: for all y, w ∈ ℝ^{N+1}, Dh(y)w = Df(tl y)(tl w) + hd(y)·(Dg(tl y)(tl w) − Df(tl y)(tl w)) + hd(w)·(g(tl y) − f(tl y)).
7. Claim (b). Take y = ι(t, x) and w = e₀. By step 2, tl y = x, hd y = t, tl e₀ = 0 and hd e₀ = 1, so by step 6 Dh(y)e₀ = Df(x)0 + t·(Dg(x)0 − Df(x)0) + 1·(g(x) − f(x)) = g(x) − f(x).
8. Claim (c). Take y = ι(t, x) and w = Jv. Then tl w = v and hd w = 0, so Dh(y)(Jv) = Df(x)v + t·(Dg(x)v − Df(x)v) + 0·(…) = Df(x)v + t(Dg(x)v − Df(x)v).
9. Claim (d). Let y = ι(t, x) and w ∈ ℝ^{N+1}. By step 6 (with tl y = x, hd y = t), the triangle inequality, ‖Au‖ ≤ ‖A‖‖u‖ and step 3: ‖Dh(y)w‖ ≤ ‖Df(x)‖‖tl w‖ + |t|(‖Dg(x)‖‖tl w‖ + ‖Df(x)‖‖tl w‖) + |hd w|·‖g(x) − f(x)‖ ≤ (‖g(x) − f(x)‖ + ‖Df(x)‖ + |t|(‖Dg(x)‖ + ‖Df(x)‖))·‖w‖. The constant in parentheses is ≥ 0, so ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound gives (d). □

subproblems.title: Smooth approximations of a Lipschitz straight-line homotopy
subproblems.statement: For all N, N' ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, every map H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} and every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N with H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) for x ∈ K and t ∈ [0, 1] (ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)), Jv := ι(0, v), e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1, D = fderiv ℝ), there are maps F_j, G_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and H_j : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} (j ∈ ℕ) and Λ' ∈ ℝ such that: (1) every F_j, G_j, H_j is C^∞; (2) ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ and ‖DG_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ for all j, x; (3) F_j → F and G_j → G uniformly on ℝ^N; (4) H_j(ι(1, x)) = G_j(x) and H_j(ι(0, x)) = F_j(x); (5) DH_j(ι(1, x))(Jv) = DG_j(x)v and DH_j(ι(0, x))(Jv) = DF_j(x)v; (6) ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))e₀‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1) for all j, t, x; (7) ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))(Jv)‖ ≤ Λ‖v‖ for all j, t ∈ [0, 1], x, v; (8) ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))‖ ≤ Λ' for all j, t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K; (9) H_j → H uniformly on {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}.

Source: parent proof step 2 (F_j := Mo(F, Λ), G_j := Mo(G, Λ), H_j the interpolation, properties (a)–(d)). Notation: ℝ^N = Euclid N; ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (the point (t, x_1, …, x_N)); Jv := ι(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; D = fderiv ℝ; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF(x)); NC X means IsCompact X.support, X.mass < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞; C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}; d := exteriorDerivative, on test forms exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m (whose coercion is exteriorDerivative of the coercion, by rfl).
1. Mollification. By Submission.cmcdt_lpo_mollify_lipschitz (the sibling (Mo)) applied to F and to G there are C^∞, Λ-Lipschitz maps F_j, G_j with dist(F_j x, F x) ≤ Λ/(j + 1) and dist(G_j x, G x) ≤ Λ/(j + 1) for all j, x. For each j apply Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_interp_calculus to f := F_j, g := G_j and let H_j be the resulting map h (choice over j). So H_j is C^∞ and, for all t, x, v: (a) H_j(ι(t, x)) = F_j x + t(G_j x − F_j x); (b) DH_j(ι(t, x))e₀ = G_j x − F_j x; (c) DH_j(ι(t, x))(Jv) = DF_j(x)v + t(DG_j(x)v − DF_j(x)v); (d) ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))‖ ≤ ‖G_j x − F_j x‖ + ‖DF_j(x)‖ + |t|(‖DG_j(x)‖ + ‖DF_j(x)‖). This gives (1).
2. Claim (2). A Λ-Lipschitz map has ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ at every point (norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz); same for G_j.
3. Claim (3). Λ/(j + 1) → 0 (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat multiplied by Λ). Given ε > 0, for all large j we have Λ/(j + 1) < ε, hence dist(F x, F_j x) < ε for every x ∈ ℝ^N; this is uniform convergence (Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff). Same for G.
4. Claim (4). (a) with t = 1 gives H_j(ι(1, x)) = F_j x + (G_j x − F_j x) = G_j x; with t = 0 it gives F_j x.
5. Claim (5). (c) with t = 1 gives DF_j(x)v + (DG_j(x)v − DF_j(x)v) = DG_j(x)v; with t = 0 it gives DF_j(x)v.
6. A difference estimate. By the triangle inequality, for all j, x: ‖G_j x − F_j x‖ = dist(G_j x, F_j x) ≤ dist(G_j x, G x) + dist(G x, F x) + dist(F x, F_j x) ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1). (*)
7. Claim (6). By (b) and (*), ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))e₀‖ = ‖G_j x − F_j x‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1).
8. Claim (7). By (c), DH_j(ι(t, x))(Jv) = (1 − t)DF_j(x)v + t·DG_j(x)v. For t ∈ [0, 1], 1 − t ≥ 0 and t ≥ 0, so by step 2 its norm is ≤ (1 − t)Λ‖v‖ + tΛ‖v‖ = Λ‖v‖.
9. Claim (8). F and G are Lipschitz, hence continuous, so x ↦ dist(F x, G x) is continuous and bounded on the compact K by some M (IsCompact.exists_bound_of_continuousOn). Put Λ' := M + 5Λ. For t ∈ [0, 1] (so |t| ≤ 1) and x ∈ K, by (d), (*), step 2 and 2Λ/(j + 1) ≤ 2Λ: ‖DH_j(ι(t, x))‖ ≤ (M + 2Λ) + Λ + 1·(Λ + Λ) = Λ'.
10. Claim (9). Let y ∈ C(K), y = ι(t, x) with t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K. By the hypothesis on H and (a), H(y) − H_j(y) = (F x + t(G x − F x)) − (F_j x + t(G_j x − F_j x)) = (1 − t)(F x − F_j x) + t(G x − G_j x), so dist(H y, H_j y) ≤ (1 − t)Λ/(j + 1) + tΛ/(j + 1) = Λ/(j + 1), a bound independent of y that tends to 0; hence H_j → H uniformly on C(K) (Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff). □

Appendix (informative; the numbered proof above is the contract). The following tactic script was compiled with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission` (Mathlib 25730c7c) as the `by` block of the declaration `theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_smooth_approx` whose type is exactly this node's frozen lean_statement, with every cited dependency declared under its exact frozen type; it produced no errors or warnings:
  intro N N' Λ F G H K hF hG hK hHK
  obtain ⟨Fs, hFs, hFL, hFd⟩ := Submission.cmcdt_lpo_mollify_lipschitz N N' Λ F hF
  obtain ⟨Gs, hGs, hGL, hGd⟩ := Submission.cmcdt_lpo_mollify_lipschitz N N' Λ G hG
  choose Hs hHs hHι hHe hHJ hHn using
    fun j => Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_interp_calculus N N' (Fs j) (Gs j) (hFs j) (hGs j)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, ∀ x ∈ K, dist (F x) (G x) ≤ M := by
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      ((hF.continuous.dist hG.continuous).continuousOn)
    exact ⟨M, fun x hx => (le_abs_self _).trans (by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hM x hx)⟩
  have hΛ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Λ := Λ.coe_nonneg
  have hDF : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) :=
    fun j x => norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ (hFL j)
  have hDG : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) :=
    fun j x => norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ (hGL j)
  have hsmall : Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h := tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat.const_mul (Λ : ℝ)
    rw [mul_zero] at h
    refine h.congr (fun j => ?_)
    rw [mul_one_div]
  have hunif : ∀ (Es : ℕ → Euclid N → Euclid N') (E : Euclid N → Euclid N'),
      (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N), dist (Es j x) (E x) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) →
      TendstoUniformly Es E atTop := by
    intro Es E hE
    rw [Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff]
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [hsmall.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with j hj x
    rw [dist_comm]
    exact (hE j x).trans_lt hj
  have hjpos : ∀ j : ℕ, (0 : ℝ) < (j : ℝ) + 1 := fun j => by positivity
  have hGF : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x : Euclid N),
      ‖Gs j x - Fs j x‖ ≤ dist (F x) (G x) + 2 * (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro j x
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    calc dist (Gs j x) (Fs j x) ≤ dist (Gs j x) (G x) + dist (G x) (F x) + dist (F x) (Fs j x) :=
          dist_triangle4 _ _ _ _
      _ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) + dist (F x) (G x) + (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by
          gcongr
          · exact hGd j x
          · rw [dist_comm]
          · rw [dist_comm]; exact hFd j x
      _ = dist (F x) (G x) + 2 * (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
  refine ⟨Fs, Gs, Hs, M + 5 * (Λ : ℝ), hFs, hGs, hHs, hDF, hDG, hunif Fs F hFd, hunif Gs G hGd,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j x; rw [hHι]; simp
  · intro j x; rw [hHι]; simp
  · intro j x v; rw [hHJ]; simp
  · intro j x v; rw [hHJ]; simp
  · intro j t x; rw [hHe]; exact hGF j x
  · intro j t ht x v
    rw [hHJ]
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v + t • (fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v - fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v) =
        (1 - t) • fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v + t • fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v := by
      rw [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    rw [h1]
    have hF' : ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact hDF j x)
    have hG' : ‖fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v‖ ≤ (Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖ :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _).trans (by gcongr; exact hDG j x)
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
    have ht1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith [ht.2]
    calc ‖(1 - t) • fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v + t • fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v‖
        ≤ ‖(1 - t) • fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v‖ + ‖t • fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = (1 - t) * ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x v‖ + t * ‖fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x v‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht1, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0]
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * ((Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖) + t * ((Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖) := by gcongr
      _ = (Λ : ℝ) * ‖v‖ := by ring
  · intro j t ht x hx
    refine (hHn j t x).trans ?_
    have h2 : 2 * (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 2 * (Λ : ℝ) :=
      div_le_self (by positivity) (by linarith [(j.cast_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j)])
    have habs : |t| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    calc ‖Gs j x - Fs j x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖ + |t| * (‖fderiv ℝ (Gs j) x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ (Fs j) x‖)
        ≤ (M + 2 * (Λ : ℝ)) + (Λ : ℝ) + 1 * ((Λ : ℝ) + (Λ : ℝ)) := by
          gcongr
          · exact (hGF j x).trans (by linarith [hM x hx])
          · exact hDF j x
          · exact hDG j x
          · exact hDF j x
      _ = M + 5 * (Λ : ℝ) := by ring
  · rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
    intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [hsmall.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)] with j hj y hy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hHK x hx t ht, hHι, dist_eq_norm]
    have h1 : F x + t • (G x - F x) - (Fs j x + t • (Gs j x - Fs j x)) =
        (1 - t) • (F x - Fs j x) + t • (G x - Gs j x) := by
      simp only [smul_sub, sub_smul, one_smul]; abel
    rw [h1]
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht.1
    have ht1 : 0 ≤ 1 - t := by linarith [ht.2]
    calc ‖(1 - t) • (F x - Fs j x) + t • (G x - Gs j x)‖
        ≤ ‖(1 - t) • (F x - Fs j x)‖ + ‖t • (G x - Gs j x)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = (1 - t) * ‖F x - Fs j x‖ + t * ‖G x - Gs j x‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht1, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht0]
      _ ≤ (1 - t) * ((Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) + t * ((Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) := by
          gcongr
          · rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]; exact hFd j x
          · rw [← dist_eq_norm, dist_comm]; exact hGd j x
      _ = (Λ : ℝ) / ((j : ℝ) + 1) := by ring
      _ < ε := hj
proof_key_steps: Mollify F, G by Submission.cmcdt_lpo_mollify_lipschitz; interpolate each pair (F_j, G_j) by Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_interp_calculus to get H_j.
Derivative bounds ‖DF_j‖, ‖DG_j‖ ≤ Λ from Lipschitz; uniform convergence from dist ≤ Λ/(j+1) → 0.
End values and end derivatives of H_j from the interpolation formulas at t = 1, 0; ‖G_j x − F_j x‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j+1).
‖DH_j(ι(t,x))(Jv)‖ ≤ Λ‖v‖ for t ∈ [0,1]; ‖DH_j‖ ≤ M + 5Λ on C(K) with M a bound of dist(F, G) on K.
H − H_j = (1−t)(F − F_j) + t(G − G_j) on C(K), so H_j → H uniformly there.

subproblems.title: Cut-off pull-backs along the smoothed homotopy and their limits under (PA)
subproblems.statement: Let lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) be an arbitrary family of currents on univ satisfying (PA) for lpush: for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, every sequence of C^∞ maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} with ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X and F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and every sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that each η_j equals F_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X: X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω). Let N, N', m ∈ ℕ, Λ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} Λ-Lipschitz, H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} L-Lipschitz, K ⊆ ℝ^N compact with H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) for x ∈ K, t ∈ [0, 1], and ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^{N'}). Then there are test forms β_j ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ_{1,j}, ρ_{0,j} ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^N) (j ∈ ℕ) such that: (i) ρ_{s,j}(x)(v) = β_j(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_m) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all j, x, v; (ii) for every X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and spt X ⊆ K: X(ρ_{1,j}) → lpush(G, X)(ω) and X(ρ_{0,j}) → lpush(F, X)(ω); (iii) for every Y ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^{N+1}) with compact support, M(Y) < ∞, boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ and spt Y ⊆ C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}: Y(β_j) → lpush(H, Y)(ω); (iv) for every such Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt Y ⊆ C(K): Y(dβ_j) → lpush(H, Y)(dω), d = exteriorDerivativeTestOn; (v) for all j, x ∈ K and t ∈ [0, 1] there are p ∈ ℝ^{N'} and a continuous linear D : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with β_j(ι(t, x)) = (ω(p)).compContinuousLinearMap D, ‖De₀‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1) and ‖D(Jv)‖ ≤ Λ‖v‖ for all v ∈ ℝ^N.

Test forms with equal values are equal (Subtype.ext, funext, ContinuousAlternatingMap.ext), and the coercion of a difference of test forms is the pointwise difference.
1. Part (a), normality. For X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N), boundaryMassOn X univ = 0 by definition (degree 0), so X is NC.
2. Part (a), slice. Apply (9) to X (degree 0) and the test form dβ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ 0 β ∈ 𝒟^1(ℝ^{N+1}): there is η ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for all x, v, and cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η).
3. Part (a), homotopy identity. By conjunct (d) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms (for N, β, x and the empty tuple v), the integral in step 2 equals β(ι(1, x))(J ∘ v) − β(ι(0, x))(J ∘ v) = ρ₁(x)(v) − ρ₀(x)(v). Hence η = ρ₁ − ρ₀ as test forms, and by linearity of X, cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀).
4. Part (b), normality. For X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N), boundaryMassOn X univ = (∂X).massOn univ = M(∂X) < ∞ (definitions), so X is NC; ∂X is NC by the hypotheses (compact support, M(∂X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞).
5. Part (b), two slices. Apply (9) to X (degree k + 1) and dβ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ (k + 1) β ∈ 𝒟^{k+2}(ℝ^{N+1}): there is η ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^N) with η(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, and cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η). Apply (9) to ∂X (degree k) and β ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}): there is θ ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with θ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 β(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt for v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, and cyl(∂X)(β) = ∂X(θ) = X(dθ), where dθ = exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ k θ (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply).
6. Part (b), homotopy identity. By conjunct (c) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_forms for β and θ (whose hypothesis is the formula for θ in step 5): for all x and v ∈ (ℝ^N)^{k+1}, ∫_0^1 dβ(ι(t, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (J ∘ v)) dt = β(ι(1, x))(J ∘ v) − β(ι(0, x))(J ∘ v) − dθ(x)(v) = ρ₁(x)(v) − ρ₀(x)(v) − dθ(x)(v). Hence η = ρ₁ − ρ₀ − dθ as test forms.
7. Conclusion of (b). By linearity, cyl(X)(dβ) = X(η) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − X(dθ) = X(ρ₁) − X(ρ₀) − cyl(∂X)(β). □

Notation: ℝ^N = Euclid N; ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (the point (t, x_1, …, x_N)); Jv := ι(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; D = fderiv ℝ; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF(x)); NC X means IsCompact X.support, X.mass < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞; C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}; d := exteriorDerivative, on test forms exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m (whose coercion is exteriorDerivative of the coercion, by rfl). For currents S, T on univ, (S − T)(ω) = S(ω) − T(ω) (the Sub instance of the contract), ∂T(ω) = T(dω) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply), and currents agreeing on all test forms are equal (GeometricCurrentOn.ext); limits of real sequences are unique (tendsto_nhds_unique).
1. Support of the boundary. By the third conjunct (SB) of Submission.cmcdt_lpo_current_toolkit applied to (VO), (REP): spt ∂X ⊆ spt X for every X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N).
2. Conjunct (10), setup. Fix N, N', Λ, L, F, G, H and X ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and the hypothesis on H over spt X. By ext it suffices to prove, for every ω ∈ 𝒟^0(ℝ^{N'}), lpush(G, X)(ω) − lpush(F, X)(ω) = lpush(H, cyl X)(dω). Apply Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_pullback_limits to (lpush, (PA), N, N', m := 0, Λ, L, F, G, H, K := spt X, ω) (spt X is compact, F, G are Λ-Lipschitz, H is L-Lipschitz): we get β_j, ρ_{1,j}, ρ_{0,j} with its properties (i)–(v).
3. Conjunct (10), normality. boundaryMassOn X univ = 0 < ∞ (degree 0), so X is NC. By (7) for X: cyl(X) has compact support, M(cyl X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn cyl(X) univ = M(∂ cyl X) < ∞, and spt cyl(X) ⊆ C(spt X).
4. Conjunct (10), limits. By (iv) with Y := cyl(X): cyl(X)(dβ_j) → lpush(H, cyl X)(dω). By (ii) with X (spt X ⊆ K): X(ρ_{1,j}) → lpush(G, X)(ω) and X(ρ_{0,j}) → lpush(F, X)(ω). By part (a) of Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_cyl_identity (with (9), X, β_j and ρ_{1,j}, ρ_{0,j}, which satisfy the end-slice formulas by (i)): cyl(X)(dβ_j) = X(ρ_{1,j}) − X(ρ_{0,j}) for every j. Hence cyl(X)(dβ_j) → lpush(G, X)(ω) − lpush(F, X)(ω) as well, and uniqueness of limits gives lpush(G, X)(ω) − lpush(F, X)(ω) = lpush(H, cyl X)(dω) = ∂ lpush(H, cyl X)(ω). This proves (10).
5. Conjunct (11), normality. Fix the data with X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^N), compact support, M(X) < ∞, M(∂X) < ∞. boundaryMassOn X univ = M(∂X) < ∞, so X is NC. ∂X is NC: spt ∂X ⊆ spt X (step 1) and spt ∂X = univ \ zeroRegion(∂X) is closed (the zero region is open), so spt ∂X is compact (IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset); M(∂X) < ∞; boundaryMassOn ∂X univ < ∞, because for k = 0 it is 0 by definition and for k = k' + 1 it is the mass of ∂∂X = 0 (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_boundary), and the zero current has mass sSup{ofReal 0} = 0.
6. Conjunct (11), setup. By ext it suffices to show, for ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}), lpush(G, X)(ω) − lpush(F, X)(ω) − lpush(H, cyl ∂X)(ω) = lpush(H, cyl X)(dω). Apply Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_pullback_limits with m := k + 1 and K := spt X: β_j, ρ_{1,j}, ρ_{0,j} with (i)–(v). By (7) for X: cyl(X) is NC with spt cyl(X) ⊆ C(spt X). By (7) for ∂X: cyl(∂X) is NC with spt cyl(∂X) ⊆ {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ spt ∂X} ⊆ C(spt X) (step 1).
7. Conjunct (11), limits. (iv) with Y := cyl(X): cyl(X)(dβ_j) → lpush(H, cyl X)(dω). (iii) with Y := cyl(∂X): cyl(∂X)(β_j) → lpush(H, cyl ∂X)(ω). (ii) with X: X(ρ_{1,j}) → lpush(G, X)(ω), X(ρ_{0,j}) → lpush(F, X)(ω). Part (b) of Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_cyl_identity (X and ∂X normal by step 5, end slices by (i)): cyl(X)(dβ_j) = X(ρ_{1,j}) − X(ρ_{0,j}) − cyl(∂X)(β_j) for every j. Passing to the limit and using uniqueness of limits: lpush(H, cyl X)(dω) = lpush(G, X)(ω) − lpush(F, X)(ω) − lpush(H, cyl ∂X)(ω). Ext gives (11). □

Notation: ℝ^N = Euclid N; ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (the point (t, x_1, …, x_N)); Jv := ι(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1; |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α; D = fderiv ℝ; F^#ω(x) := (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (DF(x)); NC X means IsCompact X.support, X.mass < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞; C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}; d := exteriorDerivative, on test forms exteriorDerivativeTestOn univ m (whose coercion is exteriorDerivative of the coercion, by rfl). M(T) = T.massOn univ is the supremum of ofReal(T(ω)) over the admissible ω (tsupport ω ⊆ univ and |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y).
1. Setup. Fix N, N', k, Λ, L, F, G, H, X, δ with the hypotheses; X is NC and dist(F x, G x) ≤ δ for x ∈ spt X. By (7) for X, cyl(X) is NC (boundaryMassOn cyl(X) univ = M(∂ cyl X) < ∞) and spt cyl(X) ⊆ C(spt X). Write T := lpush(H, cyl X) and M := M(X) < ∞.
2. Key estimate: for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N'}) with |ω(y)| ≤ 1 for all y, |T(ω)| ≤ Λ^k·δ·M.toReal. Proof: apply Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_pullback_limits with m := k + 1, K := spt X and ω; let β_j be the resulting forms. By (iii) with Y := cyl(X): cyl(X)(β_j) → T(ω). For each j apply Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_cyl_eval_bound (with (VO), (REP), the first two conjuncts (L1), (L2) of (LB), (9), X, β_j) with a_j := δ + 2Λ/(j + 1), b := Λ ≥ 0 and c := 1: its hypothesis holds because, for x ∈ spt X and t ∈ [0, 1], (v) gives p, D with β_j(ι(t, x)) = (ω(p)).compContinuousLinearMap D, ‖De₀‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1) ≤ a_j and ‖D(Jv)‖ ≤ Λ‖v‖, and γ := ω(p) has |γ| ≤ 1. Hence |cyl(X)(β_j)| ≤ Λ^k·a_j·1·M.toReal for all j. As j → ∞, |cyl(X)(β_j)| → |T(ω)| (continuity of |·|) and Λ^k·a_j·M.toReal → Λ^k·δ·M.toReal (2Λ/(j + 1) → 0), so le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' gives |T(ω)| ≤ Λ^k·δ·M.toReal.
3. Mass bound. By sSup_le it suffices to show ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ ofReal δ·(2Λ)^k·M for admissible ω. Case δ ≥ 0: T(ω) ≤ |T(ω)| ≤ Λ^k·δ·M.toReal ≤ (2Λ)^k·δ·M.toReal (0 ≤ Λ ≤ 2Λ gives Λ^k ≤ (2Λ)^k, and δ·M.toReal ≥ 0); by monotonicity of ofReal, ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ ofReal(δ·(2Λ)^k·M.toReal) = ofReal δ·ofReal((2Λ)^k)·ofReal(M.toReal) = ofReal δ·(2Λ)^k·M (ENNReal.ofReal_mul for nonnegative factors, ENNReal.ofReal_pow, ofReal(2Λ) = 2·Λ in ℝ≥0∞, and ENNReal.ofReal_toReal as M ≠ ∞).
